title: Set or change?
instruction: For each moment in the app, choose whether the variable is set to a new value or changed by a bit.

items.why: Whatever it was before, now it is “no”.

items.text: A new message arrived: one more unread
items.why: One is added to those already there.

items.text: You opened the chat: there are now zero unread

items.why: One is added to the number of items already there.

items.text: In the settings you choose dark mode

items.why: It takes a little off the volume that is there.

debrief: Set overwrites the value regardless of what was there. Change works with what is already there.
